physDesc.physMedium: 1 bifolio. Written in brown in ink. Paper: 12 staves.

annot.p: Contains drafts for thirteen songs without text numbered: No. 57, No. 69, No. 59, No. 93, No. 22, No. 43, No. 64, No. 45, No. 20, No. 57, No. 33, No. 34 and No. 64 (a second version). This song is No. 69.

physDesc.physMedium: 3 bifolios. Written in brown ink. Paper: 14 staves. First and last page blank. Contains the following songs: "No. 20 Udfrielsen af Ægypten" (HartW 376); "No. 22 Lovgivningen paa Sinai" (HartW 388); "No. 33 David og Goliath" (HartW 391); "No. 34 Davids Seiers-Sang" (HartW 375); "No. 57 Johannes den Døber" (HartW 377); "No. 59 Herrens Fristelse" (HartW 385); "No. 69 Jairi Datter"; "No. 93 Kammersvenden fra Morland" (HartW 381); and "No. 64 Peders Apostel-Kald" (HartW 378). Contrary to Hartmann's habit, the texts are written in Latin script.

Written in brown ink. Paper: 12 staves. Title above the first stave: "Jairi Datter / N.F.S. Grundtvig." In upper left-hand corner added in pencil in foreign hand: "2 Platten" and at the bottom of the page: "Verlag - Nr.". On recto and the first three staves on verso notated as vocal score. Then follows the same song in piano score.
